question: Describe this Short as a pattern, not its words; quote nothing longer than 6 words. 1) First 3 seconds: what is seen and heard from 0 to 1 s and from 1 to 3 s, when the first spoken word starts, and any on-screen text (how big against the frame, where). 2) Cut rhythm: every cut or shot change with its timestamp, then the count and the average seconds between cuts. 3) On-screen text: word-by-word captions, a title bar, cards or lists; how many words show at once; where on screen. 4) Structure as ordered beats with timestamps, each 12 words or fewer, paraphrased; mark where the main payoff lands (timestamp) and what it is. 5) The end: how it ends (a question to the viewer, a rule, a pitch, a loop back to the start) and what happens in the last 3 seconds. 6) Length, and the speaking pace in words per minute (estimate). 7) The opening move in one line (the kind of line or picture, not the words). 8) The one thing a viewer would forward, and to whom. 9) Every number or claim stated, paraphrased, and whether it names a source.
